verdict: Quiet break day: Pochettino made official, Mac Allister talks not started.

posters.headline: Pochettino starts at United
posters.summary: Sky Sports says United appointed Pochettino to 2029. Liverpool is his first game in charge.

read.what: Sky Sports reports United appointed Mauricio Pochettino on a deal to summer 2029 after sacking Michael Carrick. They must pay about £7.4m to buy him out of his USA contract. He starts on Wednesday after the USA play Haiti, and takes his first training on Thursday.
read.context: Liverpool at Anfield on 22 November is his first match in charge, live on Sky Sports. He will have about three training days. United were in the relegation zone after 10 games.
read.take: Opinion: a new manager can lift a side for a game or two, but three training days is very little to change a system. Watch which XI he picks and how high United press.

posters.headline: No Mac Allister talks yet
posters.summary: His father says renewal talks have not started. News could come before the end of the year.

read.what: ESPN reports Carlos Mac Allister saying "We haven't started renewal talks yet" and that things are "still under review". He said there may be news before the end of the year. About 20 months remain on the deal. If talks go well his son will renew, he said, and if not he will leave.
read.context: ESPN says Mac Allister has started every Premier League game this season. With Van Dijk and Alisson also out of contract next summer, the club has several big decisions.
read.take: Opinion: this is a father speaking, not the club, and nothing is agreed or denied. The key point is that no talks have begun. Watch whether Liverpool open talks before the new year.

nextMatch.teamNews: Van Dijk, Szoboszlai doubts; Gravenberch major doubt; Frimpong out. Check club for kick-off (16:00 or 16:30).

tracker.update: Father says no renewal talks yet; news possible before year end.
